name: Nylon Mono Net Fabric
description: Premium mono net fabric available in a spectrum of rich colors. Combining a sleek, smooth texture with industry-leading color retention and shrinkage resistance.

name: Cancan Net Fabric
description: Stiff, durable nylon or polyester mesh used primarily to create volume, structure, and a voluminous flared silhouette in ethnic and formal wear.

name: Football Net
description: Rigid, stiff polyester netting used primarily in garment manufacturing to add structure, volume, and flare to lehengas.

name: Organza Fabric
description: Lightweight, sheer, and plain-weave fabric. Stands out for its exceptional finish, smooth texture, and vibrant color options.

name: Viscose Velvet
description: Luxurious fabric known for its exceptionally soft, plush texture and elegant, shimmering finish. Offers a fluid drape perfect for evening gowns.

name: Embroidered Organza
description: Sheer organza fabric adorned with delicate embroidery. Ideal for dupattas, sarees, and bridal ensembles.

name: 9000 Velvet
description: Micro 9000 premium velvet designed for winter-ready warmth. Characterized by ultra-soft texture and sophisticated luster.

name: Chinon Fabric
description: Lightweight and breathable textile known for soft texture and delicate sheen. A durable variation of chiffon.

name: Digital Print Fabric
description: High level of detail and color accuracy featuring botanical watercolors to sharp geometric abstracts.

name: Fendi Fabric
description: celebrated for its signature lustrous finish and sophisticated sheen. Offers a radiant look that feels modern.

name: Pure Viscose Cosmos
description: Luxurious, lightweight textile with a shimmering metallic gold finish often termed 'Viscose Tissue Cosmos'.

name: Butter Crepe Fabric
description: Polyester-based textile prized for soft texture and silk-like appearance. Wrinkle-resistant and easy to maintain.

name: Embroidered Fabric
description: Detailed embroidery available across all fabric bases including organza, viscose, and velvet.
